method: Complete candidate survey followed by individual editorial choices and written reasons, applied to the existing complete guide to keep it within 300 quotations. All verified authorized selections included. Priority given to foundational teachings, substantive explanations, necessary qualifications, distinctive applications, narrative examples and thematic breadth across mercy and the breadth of intercession, grief and consolation for those who remain, prayers for children, parents, spouses, companions and communities, the images of the welcomed guest, the bird, light, the garden and continued growth, and humility, remembrance and practical service. Neither citation count nor source order used as a ranking rule. Imported wording checked separately; version differences remain explicit. The existing reading arc is retained.

selected.text: O Lord! Purify her from her sins and forgive her through Thy mercy, O Thou Most Merciful of the merciful ones!
selected.reason: Brief prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá to purify a departed woman from her sins through mercy.

selected.text: O my Lord! Immerse him in the ocean of Thy great mercy and lead him to the fountains of Thy pardon, O Forgiver of sins!
selected.reason: Simple prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá to immerse the departed in the ocean of great mercy.

selected.text: That is why, in the prayers of Baha'u'llah, the forgiveness and pardon of God are implored for those who have ascended to the next world.
selected.reason: Mandatory inclusion: exact selected wording lies in a catalogue-authorized paragraph of this translation version.

selected.text: O Lord! Grant her shelter in Thy most glorious Kingdom beneath the shade of the Divine Lote-Tree, and bestow upon her the gift of meeting Thee
selected.reason: Brief prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá for shelter beneath the Divine Lote-Tree and the gift of meeting.

selected.text: With an awakened, mindful and attracted heart one must seek forgiveness for the deceased. Assuredly pardon and forgiveness will encompass them.
selected.reason: Counsel of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá that forgiveness be sought for the deceased with an awakened, mindful and attracted heart, with assurance that pardon will encompass them; a necessary qualification on the manner of prayer.

selected.text: Grieve not, for thy Lord is verily the Forgiving, the Merciful. Say: Let her not be sorrowful but hold fast to the cord of steadfastness
selected.reason: Counsel of Bahá’u’lláh, Grieve not, for thy Lord is the Forgiving, the Merciful, with the call to hold fast to the cord of steadfastness; a brief word of consolation.

selected.text: Yes, surely sincere prayer always has its effect, and it has a great influence in the other word. We are never cut off from those who are there.
selected.reason: Reported words of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá that sincere prayer has a great influence in the other world and that we are never cut off from those who are there; a foundational assurance of continuing connection.

selected.text: O Lord! Forgive him and accept his repentance and pardon him and cause him to enter the gardens of Thy mercy and grant him the gift of meeting Thee.
selected.reason: Brief prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá to accept the departed’s repentance and grant the gift of meeting.

selected.text: My God, my God! I beseech Thee by Thy Name, the All-Loving, to spread out for those who have ascended unto Thee the carpet of mercy and forgiveness.
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh to spread out the carpet of mercy and forgiveness for all who have ascended; a short universal petition.

selected.text: O God! Verily, I prostrate my face upon the dust and supplicate to Thy celestial kingdom to forgive Thy maidservant who hath hearkened to Thy call
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá, face upon the dust, for a maidservant who hearkened to God’s call.

selected.text: O Lord! Glorify his station and grant him an exalted seat of truth, adorn his wings with feathers so that he may soar unto the limitless realms above
selected.reason: Request of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá that the departed soul’s wings be adorned with feathers to soar unto the limitless realms above.

selected.text: O Lord, quench his thirst, cool his burning, heal his illness, and cause him to enter the verdant garden and grant him eternal life in the Paradise of Refuge.
selected.reason: Concise prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá to quench the departed’s thirst, cool his burning and heal his illness.

selected.text: Lord! Have mercy on them and grant them an exalted station in Your ancient Kingdom, and bestow upon them great success, and encompass them with manifest bounty.
selected.reason: Brief prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá for an exalted station, great success and manifest bounty for the departed.

selected.text: O Lord! Honor the resting place of those who have arrived at the gate of Thy Oneness, grant them a blessed dwelling, admit them into the court of Thy holiness
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá to honor the resting place of those who have arrived at the gate of Oneness.

selected.text: O my Lord, the All-Forgiving, the Merciful! Verily Thy servant Muhammad Ibrahim longed for the Garden of Delights and yearned to meet Thee in the Great Paradise
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá for Muhammad Ibrahim, who longed for the Garden of Delights.

selected.text: O Lord! Forgive his sins, pardon his errors, overlook his shortcomings, deal with him through grace and bounty. Grant that yearning one entry to the divine pavilion
selected.reason: Petition of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá to forgive, pardon and overlook shortcomings, dealing with the departed through grace and bounty.

selected.text: O God! O Forgiver of errors and Pardoner of sins and wrongdoings! You forgive whomsoever You wish through Your all-embracing mercy and Your resplendent compassion
selected.reason: Invocation of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá to the Forgiver of errors Who forgives whomsoever He wishes through all-embracing mercy; states the ground on which every petition in the guide rests.

selected.text: I beseech Thee by the pearls hidden in the ocean of Thy knowledge and the mysteries treasured in the repositories of Thy protection to forgive him and those who visit him
selected.reason: Plea of Bahá’u’lláh to forgive a departed believer and those who visit him.

selected.text: Thou seest me in this day shut up in my prison, and fallen into the hands of Thine adversaries, and beholdest my son (The Purest Branch) lying on the dust before Thy face.
selected.reason: Mandatory inclusion: exact selected wording lies in a catalogue-authorized paragraph of this translation version.

selected.text: O Lord! Admit this pure and sanctified leaf into the gardens of Thy oneness and the paradise of Thy sanctification. Verily Thou art the Forgiving, the Kind, the Merciful
selected.reason: Concise prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá admitting a pure leaf into the gardens of oneness.

selected.text: O Lord! Immerse these ascending souls in the ocean of forgiveness. Forgive sins, bestow gifts, cause them to be immersed in the ocean of lights in the Kingdom of mysteries.
selected.reason: Collective prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá to immerse ascending souls in the ocean of forgiveness and of lights.

selected.text: O Merciful Lord! These two blessed souls were two bright candles who rendered service to the human world … May all-encompassing forgiveness be granted and everlasting life be realized
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá for two blessed souls who were bright candles rendering service to the human world.

selected.text: O Lord! Shelter him in the vicinity of Thy Most Great Forgiveness, cause him to enter into the heart of the Most Glorious Paradise, and make him abide forever in Thy Most Exalted Kingdom.
selected.reason: Concise prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá for shelter in the Most Great Forgiveness and eternal abiding in the Kingdom.

selected.text: O Lord! Nurture him with the drops from the cloud of Thy mercy, cause him to grow through the warmth of the Sun of Thy forgiveness and pardon, make him to wave in the breeze of Thy grace
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá that the departed be nurtured by the cloud of mercy and grow in the warmth of the Sun of forgiveness; an image of growth continuing after death.

selected.text: O peerless Lord! Nurture this dear friend and adorn his crown with the gift of bounty. Grant him the diadem of eternal sovereignty and place upon his head the crown of heavenly bestowal.
selected.reason: Petition of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá that a dear friend be given the diadem of eternal sovereignty and the crown of heavenly bestowal.

selected.text: O my God! O my God! Verily, Thy handmaiden of immaculate character, whose name is Ma'sumih … Aid her in the world of eternity and cause her to dwell in the precincts of Thy most great mercy
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá for the handmaiden Ma’sumih, of immaculate character, to dwell in the precincts of mercy.

selected.text: O Lord! Embrace him with forgiveness and pardon, O my Lord, the All-Merciful. Admit him into the Garden of Paradise, and cause his breast to expand through entering into the heart of Paradise.
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá that the departed’s breast expand through entering into the heart of Paradise.

selected.text: O Forgiver! Forgive them both and shelter them in Thy protection. Thou art the Forgiver, the Bestower, the Kind, and Thou art the Giver, the Everlasting, the All-Forgiving, the All-Merciful
selected.reason: Brief prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá, O Forgiver! Forgive them both and shelter them in Thy protection; a concise petition for two souls.

selected.text: O my God, my God! Verily, a bird from among the birds of Thy holy gardens hath winged its flight to the pavilions of Thy mercy … Pour forth all patience and solace upon its dear and loving mother
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá for a bird of the holy gardens winged to the pavilions of mercy, with patience and solace for its loving mother; keeps a parent’s loss of a child.

selected.text: My God! My God! Verily Your servant Nazim was one who suppressed anger and forgave sins and harm … make his arrival praiseworthy and his advent blessed, and immerse him in the seas of Your favors
selected.reason: Remembrance by ‘Abdu’l-Bahá of Nazim, who suppressed anger and forgave harm; character itself as remembrance.

selected.text: I beseech Thee, O Lord of all beings, to forgive Thy handmaiden who hath ascended unto Thee, and to cause her to associate with the countenances of Paradise on high in the white and crimson chambers
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh that a handmaiden associate with the countenances of Paradise in the white and crimson chambers.

selected.text: Raise His station! Ordain all good for Him and ordain the glances of Thy favour for Him and immerse Him in the sea of mysteries in the Kingdom of Light, in that Assembly where Thy Beauty is manifest.
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá to raise a soul’s station and immerse it in the sea of mysteries in the Kingdom of Light.

selected.text: I beseech God to immerse you in the seas of forgiveness, clothe you in the robes of beneficence, admit you to the garden of paradise, and grant you the blessing of His presence in the highest heavens.
selected.reason: Words of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá beseeching that the one addressed be clothed in robes of beneficence and granted God’s presence in the highest heavens.

selected.text: O handmaiden of God! We have come to visit thee and have approached thy resting place, and we beseech God to grant thee at all times what He hath ordained in the highest Paradise for the people of Baha.
selected.reason: Words of Bahá’u’lláh at a handmaiden’s resting place beseeching for her what is ordained in the highest Paradise for the people of Bahá.

selected.text: O Lord! These servants are Your friends and these handmaidens are Your cherished ones at Your threshold … Grant them entrance to Your Kingdom and bestow upon them a nest and dwelling in the eternal garden
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá that servants and handmaidens be given a nest and dwelling in the eternal garden.

selected.text: O God! O Thou Who hast shed the light of forgiveness upon human temples … Verily Thou art the Merciful, verily Thou art the Kind, verily Thou art the Forgiving, the Loving, the Compassionate, the All-Wise
selected.reason: Invocation of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá to God Who hast shed the light of forgiveness upon human temples.

selected.text: O Lord! Pour upon him the cup of bestowal, overlook his mistakes, and grant him a seat of truth in Thy Most Glorious Kingdom. Illumine his eyes with the vision of Thy beauty in the gathering of the Meeting.
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá to overlook a soul’s mistakes and grant him a seat of truth with the vision of beauty.

selected.text: O Lord! Make noble their dwelling place, expand their abode, fulfill their desires, prepare for them their wishes, deprive them not of Thy favors, and let them not be bereft of the most wondrous attributes.
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá that the departed not be deprived of favors and that their desires be fulfilled.

selected.text: O Lord! Khodadad has taken flight from this ruined nest to build his home and dwelling upon the free cypress in the realm of heaven. O Lord! Grant those two companion birds shelter beneath that fruitful tree.
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá for Khodadad, flown from a ruined nest to the free cypress of heaven, and for two companion birds.

selected.text: O Lord, Lord! With complete humility I stretch forth my hands in supplication toward the Kingdom of pardon and forgiveness … Verily Thou art the Forgiver, the Generous, the Pardoner, the Mighty, the Bestower
selected.reason: Supplication of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá with complete humility toward the Kingdom of pardon and forgiveness.

selected.text: Aid him through Your grace and bounty, O Helper of the weak! Shelter him in the shadow of Your pardon, O Succorer of the poor! Comfort him in the expanses of Your court, O Companion of those who seek refuge!
selected.reason: Invocations of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá to the Helper of the weak, Succorer of the poor and Companion of those who seek refuge, from the prayer marking the passing of Mirza Ibrahim Afnan.

selected.text: O my God! O Thou Remover of adversities and Dispeller of afflictions! I, verily, implore Thee, as one beset by trouble imploreth the Almighty and Most Exalted King; and I beseech Thee, as one burdened with sin beseecheth the Lord of pardon and forgiveness
selected.reason: Mandatory inclusion: exact selected wording lies in a catalogue-authorized paragraph of this translation version.

selected.text: O Forgiving and Merciful Lord! My dear sister Margaret has hastened from this world to Your world, and grown weary of the mortal realm to soar to the divine realm … O Lord! Grant pardon and bestow forgiveness
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá for a dear sister, Margaret, who grew weary of the mortal realm and soared to the divine realm.

selected.text: O my God, O my God! From dawn until dusk Thou seest me imploring at the gate of Thy mercy … make him pure and sanctified in the garden of immortality, brilliant and radiant from the horizon of grace and bounty
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá, imploring from dawn until dusk at the gate of mercy, that a departed soul be made pure in the garden of immortality.

selected.text: O my God! O my God! This is Thy servant, associated with the Beloved Leader of the Messengers at Thy holy threshold among all worlds … assist him with Thy confirmations and revive his spirit with Thy breaths
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá that a servant associated with the holy threshold be assisted with confirmations and his spirit revived.

selected.text: the Kingdom of the All-Merciful. Mihtar Mihraban turned toward the Threshold. O Kind Lord! Give these wandering souls shelter and protection in Your care, and bestow eternal life upon these lifeless spirits so that they may soar in the heights of forgiveness and establish an everlasting foundation
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá to give wandering souls shelter and eternal life to soar in the heights of forgiveness.

selected.text: O Lord! Encompass him with the glances of the eye of Thy mercy and assign unto him an exalted station in the kingdom of Thy oneness. Make him attain the cup of pardon and forgiveness in the paradise of Thy divinity.
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá for an exalted station and the cup of pardon in the paradise of divinity.

selected.text: O Lord! Let the outpouring of meeting with Thee be continuous upon him, and grant him the greatest gift and supreme bounty. Verily, Thou art the Giving, the Generous, the Pardoning, the Forgiving, the All-Bestowing.
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá that the outpouring of meeting with God be continuous upon the departed.

selected.text: O Lord! Give this mother and child refuge and shelter in the midst of the Most Glorious Paradise, and after their ascension from this lower world, grant them dwelling and abode in the vicinity of Your Greatest Mercy.
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá that a mother and child be given refuge together in the Most Glorious Paradise.

selected.text: O Lord! Intoxicate him with the pure wine of reunion and the nectar of bestowal in the world of eternity. Verily Thou art the Generous, the Merciful, the Compassionate, the Forgiving, the Pardoning, the Ever-Relenting.
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá that the departed be intoxicated with the pure wine of reunion in the world of eternity.

selected.text: We beseech God, the Lord of the Throne and earth, and the Lord of the Hereafter and of the former times, to adorn thee with the ornament of His pardon and forgiveness and to send down upon thee mercy from His presence.
selected.reason: Blessing of Bahá’u’lláh that the addressee be adorned with pardon and receive mercy from God’s presence.

selected.text: "O Gracious Lord! Make the brilliant lamp of Jinab-i-Sadiq a lofty palm tree in the garden of the Kingdom, and make him a radiant candle in the hidden world's assembly. Forgive sins, grant shelter, bestow eternal life."
selected.reason: Quoted prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá that Jinab-i-Sadiq become a lofty palm tree in the garden of the Kingdom and a radiant candle in the hidden world.

selected.text: My God, my God! Thou art the Succourer and Thou art the Helper … Make him to graze in the meadows of Thy forgiveness, [to wade] in the waters of Thy pardon, and to delight in meeting Thee in the paradise of Thy oneness
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá that the departed graze in the meadows of forgiveness and wade in the waters of pardon.

selected.text: I beseech Thee by the Dawning-Places of Thy Cause and the Sources of Thy Revelation and the Recipients of Thy knowledge to make mention of my father who hath ascended unto Thee in the Crimson Book from Thy Most Exalted Pen
selected.reason: Petition of Bahá’u’lláh that the supplicant’s departed father be mentioned in the Crimson Book by the Most Exalted Pen; a distinctive prayer for a father.

selected.text: O Kind God! The youth Sohrab Kamyab did not take any share from the rose garden of life and found no portion from the garden of fulfillment. In the prime of youth he left this transient world and hastened to Your threshold
selected.reason: Lament of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá for the youth Sohrab Kamyab, who left the world in the prime of youth with no share of life’s rose garden; names the sorrow of an unfulfilled life.

selected.text: I supplicate with utmost humility at the threshold of the Self-Sufficient Lord that He may grant His servant an eternal dwelling in His Kingdom and bestow a shelter and refuge under the shade of the Tree of the All-Merciful.
selected.reason: Humble supplication of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá for an eternal dwelling beneath the shade of the Tree of the All-Merciful.

selected.text: O my God, my Hope, my Protection, my Desire, my Refuge and my Succor! You see me humbled, broken, with my face in the dust, hoping and yearning for Your pardon and forgiveness for him who has sought the gate of Your mercy
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá, humbled and broken, hoping for pardon for one who sought the gate of mercy.

selected.text: Regarding the takbir in the Prayer for the Dead that you wrote about - although in language takbir means saying "Allahu Akbar", in Baha'i usage it means the greeting, and the greeting of the people of Baha is "Allah-u-Abha".
selected.reason: Explanation of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá that the takbir of the Prayer for the Dead means, in Bahá’í usage, the greeting Allah-u-Abha; a distinctive point of practice.

selected.text: To increase the spirit and fragrance of that loving father in the Garden of Paradise, ye must give to charitable causes, bestow upon the poor, show kindness to orphans, assist the helpless, and aid and care for the destitute.
selected.reason: Tablet of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá directing gifts to charitable causes, kindness to orphans and care for the destitute to increase a departed father’s spirit in Paradise; the guide’s key practical form of remembrance.

selected.text: O matchless Lord! Guide the poor and helpless Dawlat to Thy court. Forgive her sins and pardon her faults, accept her in Thy pavilion, and make her survivors the recipients of Thy gracious glance. Thou art the Forgiver, the Kind.
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá for the poor and helpless Dawlat, asking pardon for her and a gracious glance for her survivors.

selected.text: we beseech Him, exalted be He, to forgive him who has ascended unto Him, to cause him to enter the most exalted Paradise, and to make him a companion of those near ones and the sincere ones. Verily He is the Forgiving, the Merciful
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh that one who has ascended be forgiven and made a companion of the near ones and the sincere.

selected.text: O Thou Forgiving Lord! … Although some souls have spent the days of their lives in ignorance, and became estranged and contumacious, yet, with one wave from the ocean of Thy forgiveness, all those encompassed by sin will be set free
selected.reason: Mandatory inclusion: exact selected wording lies in a catalogue-authorized paragraph of this translation version.

selected.text: We beseech God, exalted be He, to send down upon her a blessing from the heaven of His grace and a mercy from the clouds of His generosity, and to cause her to enter the most exalted Paradise. Verily, He is the Hearer, the Answerer.
selected.reason: Brief prayer of Bahá’u’lláh for blessing and mercy for a departed woman and her entry into Paradise.

selected.text: O Kind Lord, grant these two birds of the meadow of certitude a nest in the Divine Lote Tree, intoxicate them with the dawn breezes of the Dove of Oneness, console those left behind, and grant patience and forbearance in separation.
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá that two birds of certitude find a nest in the Divine Lote Tree and that those left behind be granted patience in separation; joins the bird image with care for survivors.

selected.text: My Lord and my hope! Thou seest me with my face in the dust, prostrate before Thy countenance … that Thou forgive the parents of this servant who is attracted by the fragrances of Thy holiness and enkindled with the fire of Thy love
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá, face in the dust, asking forgiveness for the parents of a servant enkindled with the fire of God’s love.

selected.text: These pure, content and well-pleased souls were confident in Thy favors, relied upon Thy attributes, and trusted in Thy aid … O Merciful Lord! They were hopeful - let them not be disappointed. They were yearning - make them content
selected.reason: Plea of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá for hopeful souls: they were hopeful, let them not be disappointed; a memorable petition.

selected.text: Lord, Lord! Settle him in Your dwelling, admit him to Your holy court, shade him with the tree of Your companionship, perfect Your favor upon him, complete Your mercy for him, grant him nearness to You, and honor him with meeting You.
selected.reason: Petition of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá to complete His mercy for the departed and honor him with meeting.

selected.text: O Lord! Send down upon him from the clouds of Thy loving-kindness the rains of Thy mercy, and from the heaven of Thy generosity that which will draw him near unto Thee in all conditions. Verily Thou art the All-Bountiful, the Most Generous.
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh for rains of mercy that draw the departed near in all conditions.

selected.text: O my God, my Lord, my Support, and the Ultimate Goal of my hopes! This servant was stirred by the fragrances of Thy holiness … Admit him into the lofty chambers of the highest heaven. Verily, Thou art the Most Merciful, the Compassionate
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá for a servant stirred by holy fragrances to enter the lofty chambers of heaven.

selected.text: A prayer seeking forgiveness was offered at the Threshold of Oneness for Aqa Mirza Habibullah who was drowned in the ocean of mercy, and I hope that God's grace and bounty in that other world will encompass that truthful servant of the Lord.
selected.reason: Report by ‘Abdu’l-Bahá that a prayer of forgiveness was offered for Aqa Mirza Habibullah, with hope that grace encompass him in the other world.

selected.text: Glory be unto Thee, O my God and the God of all names … I beseech Thee by the resplendent Light and by Thy firm, penetrating Command to forgive me and my parents … to fulfill my needs and the needs of Thy servants who have turned unto Thee
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh for forgiveness for the supplicant and his parents and for the needs of God’s servants.

selected.text: O Kind Lord! Give milk from the breast of forgiveness to Your servant Ardishir Pur Bahram, and be forgiving and kind to Your bondsman Mihraban Pur Bahram, and make Your dear handmaiden Firuz daughter of Surush a messenger of the higher realm.
selected.reason: Petitions of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá to give milk from the breast of forgiveness to Ardishir Pur Bahram and kindness to his kin.

selected.text: A prayer for forgiveness was offered for the one who has ascended to God, Aqa Masihullah, and likewise another prayer for forgiveness was offered for the two who have attained the Supreme Companion, Jinab-i-Haji Ghulamrida and Mulla Aqa Baba.
selected.reason: Notice by ‘Abdu’l-Bahá of prayers for forgiveness offered for three named departed believers.

selected.text: O Lord! Thy grief-stricken servant has beseeched this lowly one to worship at Thy divine threshold and seek pardon and forgiveness, that Thou mayest immerse the father, mother and sister of this pure-hearted one in the ocean of Thy forgiveness.
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá, offered at a grief-stricken servant’s request, for the father, mother and sister of that pure-hearted one.

selected.text: We beseech God to ordain for him the reward of those who attained the presence of the Countenance and were blessed to hearken to the call of their Lord … and the reward of those who circumambulated the Throne and drank the Kawthar of immortality
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh that the departed receive the reward of those who attained the presence and drank the Kawthar of immortality.

selected.text: I stretch forth unto Thee the hands of supplication and entreaty, and call upon Thee with utmost humility and contrition, seeking forgiveness for Thy pure and holy handmaiden … My Lord! Embrace this tranquil soul with Thy pardon and forgiveness
selected.reason: Supplication of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá, with humility and contrition, for a pure handmaiden’s tranquil soul.

selected.text: O Lord! Verily Thy pure handmaiden, who is related to Thy servant Muhammad-Qabli-'Ali who hath ascended to the kingdom of Thy mercy … O Lord! Ordain for her every good in the next world and send down upon her the outpourings of mercy from heaven
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá for a handmaiden related to Muhammad-Qabli-‘Ali, asking every good in the next world.

selected.text: Lord! Raise high his stations and prepare for him an abode in the highest ranks and make him an intimate companion in the Kingdom of Beauty and an associate in the Heaven of Glory and one immersed in the sea of light in the Kingdom of Mysteries
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá that the departed become an intimate companion in the Kingdom of Beauty, immersed in the sea of light.

selected.text: Send down Thy blessings, Thy prayers, and Thy salutations upon the mother who bore him, and the breasts that suckled him, and the arms that nurtured him, and pour forth upon her patience and solace through Thy greatest mercy and Thy mighty gift.
selected.reason: Mandatory inclusion: exact selected wording lies in a catalogue-authorized paragraph of this translation version.

selected.text: O Lord! Honor his abode, accept him at Thy luminous threshold, establish him in the midst of the supreme Paradise, and shelter him in the vicinity of Thy greatest mercy, that he may warble upon the branches of Paradise with the doves of holiness
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá that the departed warble upon the branches of Paradise with the doves of holiness.

selected.text: My God, my God! A bird from among the birds of the gardens of mystical knowledge has soared to Thy sacred gardens … O Lord! Illumine his countenance with the light of forgiveness and pardon, and cause him to enter Thy Kingdom, O my Merciful Lord
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá for a bird of the gardens of mystical knowledge soared to God’s sacred gardens.

selected.text: O Lord! Khosrow Parsi and Gushtasb were unfulfilled in this world - make them successful in that world. Make them joyful, grant them a good end. Fulfill the desires of their hearts and souls. Forgive their sins, bestow and shower favors upon them.
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá that two souls unfulfilled in this world be made successful in that world.

selected.text: O Lord! A cherished handmaiden has hastened to Thy threshold and departed this world in hope. O God, guide all to the rose-garden and bring kind Bahram into the heavenly realm, and make Mihrban-Bahram drink the sweet wine of pardon and forgiveness.
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá for a cherished handmaiden who departed in hope and for named friends.

selected.text: O Lord, Cherisher of servants! Guide this loving father to the highest Paradise, and forgive his sins and errors, so that in the other world, with a radiant countenance, he may be gathered among the noble ones and be the object of Thy gracious regard.
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá that a loving father be guided to the highest Paradise and gathered with a radiant countenance among the noble ones.

selected.text: O Lord! Through Thy grace and bounty, confirm his reliance upon Thee and his belief in Thy pardon and forgiveness … elevate his stations and establish him in lofty gardens. Admit him to the garden of meeting and seat him upon the throne of eternity
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá confirming a soul’s reliance on pardon and seating him upon the throne of eternity.

selected.text: my God, O my God! Verily Thy servant Ishaq hath passed into eclipse, hath lost this first life, and hath bequeathed unto his family grief and sorrow, anguish and burning pain. Their eyes have overflowed with tears, and the fire of sadness hath been kindled within their hearts
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá for Ishaq describing the tears and burning sorrow he bequeathed to his family; joins the departed and the bereaved in one petition.

selected.text: O my God! O my God! These two pure souls have turned to the Kingdom of Thy mercy … Make their final destination the beginning of Thy favors, admit them to the pavilion of Thy holiness, cause them to abide eternally in the gatherings of Thy companionship
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá that two souls’ final destination be made the beginning of favors; echoes the guide’s image of a new beginning.

selected.text: O Lord! Grant rest to his spirit through Thy mercy and give him glad tidings of Thy pardon and forgiveness, cause him to alight in a blessed dwelling at Thy threshold, immerse him in the seas of Thy mercy and submerge him in the depths of Thy forgiveness
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá that the departed spirit be given rest and glad tidings of pardon.

selected.text: O Forgiver! The wise servant of the court, Gushtasp, turned his face from this dark world and hastened to the realm above … O Lord! Teach him supplication and prayer, forgive his sins, kindle the lamp of bounty, and burn away the veil of vain imaginings
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá that Gushtasp be taught supplication and the veil of vain imaginings burned away; growth continuing after death.

selected.text: O God, my Mighty Shelter and Most Exalted Refuge! You see me shedding tears, heaving sighs, and overwhelmed with grief at the calamities that have befallen me and the successive afflictions that have come upon me - namely the passing of Your sincere servants
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá shedding tears and overwhelmed with grief at the successive passing of sincere servants; gives direct voice to the grief the guide makes room for.

selected.text: I have beseeched the Court of Oneness that He may immerse thy pure-born parents in the ocean of His forgiveness and pardon, admit them into the eternal Paradise--the Garden of Meeting and the Garden of Immortality--and make them the recipients of His infinite favors
selected.reason: Petition of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá that the addressee’s parents be immersed in forgiveness and admitted to the Garden of Meeting and the Garden of Immortality.

selected.text: O Lord! Honor his resting place, fulfill his hopes, reach him with pardon and forgiveness, and grant him grace and beneficence. … O Lord! Forgive the errors, increase the gifts, hold us not to account for sins, remove sorrows, conceal faults, O Knower of the unseen
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá to honor a resting place and then, for us as well, to remove sorrows and conceal faults.

selected.text: O Lord! Honor her resting place, comfort her spirit, make excellent her return unto Thee, make her happy in her arrival at the gate of Thy oneness and her entrance to the springs of the fountain of Thy mercy, and shelter her in the proximity of Thy greatest mercy
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá that a handmaiden be made happy in her arrival at the gate of oneness.

selected.text: I supplicate before Thee with heart, spirit and tongue, beseeching mercy, kindness, pardon and forgiveness for Thy Hand of the Cause, Thy servant Adib, the beloved and noble one … O Lord, permit him to enter the kingdom of lights and abide in the sea of mysteries
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá for the Hand of the Cause Adib to enter the kingdom of lights and abide in the sea of mysteries.

selected.text: O God, O Bestower of Grace! Forgive Khodadad and make Firuzih victorious. Make these two pure souls radiant and render them joyous and delighted in the realm of the celestial spheres. … O Lord! They have been freed from the world of dust and have taken refuge in Thee
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá for Khodadad and Firuzih, freed from the world of dust and taking refuge in God.

selected.text: O Lord of great forgiveness and supreme bounty! Thou forgivest whomsoever Thou willest, pardonest whomsoever Thou willest, and transformest evil deeds into good ones for whomsoever Thou willest … I implore Thee to forgive Thy servant who was overcome by Thy mysteries
selected.reason: Invocation by ‘Abdu’l-Bahá of God Who transforms evil deeds into good, for a servant overcome by His mysteries.

selected.text: O Lord, immerse him in the ocean of forgiveness and purify him from the stain of disobedience and protect him from the fires and admit him into the midst of Paradise and make him abide eternally in the Garden of Good-Pleasure and grant him the blessing of meeting You
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá for purification from disobedience and abiding in the Garden of Good-Pleasure.

selected.text: O Lord! Honor her resting place, fulfill her hopes, illumine her countenance, and kindle her lamp in the glass of Your Kingdom. Open before her the doors of Your bounty, admit her into the precincts of Your mercy, grant her eternal life in the paradise of Your Glory
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá to kindle a handmaiden’s lamp in the glass of the Kingdom.

selected.text: And I beseech for your mother, who has returned to God, that He may honor her resting place, admit her to a noble dwelling, immortalize her in the Garden of Delights, and gladden her heart through beholding the lights of the Divine Presence in the scenes of grandeur.
selected.reason: Petition of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá that the addressee’s mother, returned to God, be honored in her resting place and gladdened by the lights of the Divine Presence.

selected.text: I will presently pray fervently to the Abha Kingdom, begging ample forgiveness for thy bereaved mother, that her noble soul may be purged of the defilement of transgressions, and, through the radiance of His supernal light, shine resplendent in the limitless Kingdom.
selected.reason: Promise of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá to pray fervently for ample forgiveness for the addressee’s mother, that her soul shine resplendent in the limitless Kingdom.

selected.text: O Thou kind Lord! Pour into his mouth a draught of that wine of the All-Merciful, that he may be filled with joy and waft musk-like fragrance. Immerse him in the ocean of pardon and forgiveness, and illumine him with the lights of grace and bounty. Console the heart of his loving father, and release his affectionate uncles from sorrow and grief. Grant solace to their hearts, and gladden
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá for a departed youth with consolation for his loving father and release of his uncles from grief; widens comfort to the whole family.

selected.text: My Lord! Fulfill her hopes, facilitate her desires, grant her happiness, open before her face the doors of meeting in the Most Glorious Kingdom, bestow upon her nearness and proximity, effusion of lights, immersion in the sea of reunion, and attainment of ultimate hopes.
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá opening the doors of meeting and immersion in the sea of reunion for a departed woman.

selected.text: We beseech God, blessed and exalted be He, to forgive him and his wife who heard and responded and ascended unto God, the Lord of all worlds. We beseech God to send down upon her a mercy from His presence and to cause her to enter the highest Paradise as a bounty from Him
selected.reason: Prayer of Bahá’u’lláh that a believer and his wife, who heard and responded, be forgiven and that she enter the highest Paradise.

selected.text: O Lord! O Lord! Submerge him in the ocean of Thy glory. O Lord! O Lord! Usher him into Thy delectable garden. O Lord! O Lord! Usher him into Thy lofty paradise, and cause him to be present in Thy meeting of transfiguration. O Lord! Submerge him in the ocean of Thy lights.
selected.reason: Reported prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá in Los Angeles that the departed be submerged in the ocean of glory and the ocean of lights.

selected.text: O my God! This is Your servant and the son of Your servant who was set aflame with the fire of Your love and was attracted by Your holy fragrances … until his spirit ascended to the vicinity of Your mercy and soared to the Kingdom of immortality through Your grace and gift
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá for a servant, son of a servant, set aflame with love until his spirit ascended.

selected.text: O my God! This is Your servant who claims kinship with Your servant who was honored to attain Your holy presence … O Lord! Send down upon his grave layers of light from the Kingdom of Revelation, grant repose to his spirit in the gardens of the Kingdom of might and joy
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá for a kinsman of one who attained the holy presence, asking layers of light upon his grave.

selected.text: I beseech God to illumine that blessed earth with brilliant lights from the Abha Kingdom and to assist those who visit that radiant dust with divine confirmation, that they may pray God to forgive them and pardon their sins and immerse them forever in the ocean of His mercy
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá that a blessed earth be illumined and that those who visit that radiant dust be confirmed to pray for the departed’s forgiveness.

selected.text: Your letters are filled with mention of the friends of God and requests for forgiveness for those who have ascended. In the Holy Shrine, with utmost humility, I beseech assistance and bounty for the friends and seek pardon and forgiveness for those who have ascended to God.
selected.reason: Account of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá praying at the Holy Shrine for assistance for the friends and for pardon for those who have ascended.

selected.text: O Lord! Bamas Bahram yearned to see You, hastened to the upper realm and took refuge at the threshold so that he might enter the court. O Forgiver! Treat him as befits Your Lordship, come to his aid, forgive him, grant him the vision of You, and make him abide in Your realm.
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá that Bamas Bahram be treated as befits God’s Lordship and granted the vision of Him.

selected.text: O God! The sincere are immersed in the ocean of Thy mercy, the near ones take refuge in the shelter of Thy clemency, the tongues of the enraptured sing Thy praises amidst Thy people, the assured hold fast to Thy forgiveness, and the confident trust in Thy grace and Thy favor.
selected.reason: Depiction by ‘Abdu’l-Bahá of the sincere, the near, the enraptured and the confident, each trusting God’s mercy in a different way.

selected.text: O Lord! Your servant who drank the wine of Your knowledge and whose breast was dilated through the light of certitude in Your Cause has ascended to You … Immerse him in the ocean of forgiveness and cause him to enter under the shade of the blessed tree in the highest paradise
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá for a servant whose breast was dilated by certitude, to be sheltered beneath the blessed tree.

selected.text: Immerse him in the seas of Thy favors, admit him to Thy garden of oneness and paradise of mercy, and grant him eternal life in the gathering of divine encounter, the center of lights and the kingdom of mysteries, after his ascension from this world to the realm of permanence.
selected.reason: Petition of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá for entry into the garden of oneness and eternal life in the gathering of divine encounter.

selected.text: O Lord! Shelter Nushiravan in the refuge of Thy mercy, and grant Isfandiyar Mihraban a dwelling place in the Garden of Paradise and the heavenly Paradise. Forgive and pardon Firuz Javanmard, and grant absolution to Siyyid Husayn Mirza Ja'far in the presence of Thy great mercy.
selected.reason: Named requests of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá for shelter, dwelling, pardon and absolution for four souls.

selected.text: O my kind Lord! This ancient servant and old attendant was, from early childhood, nourished at the breast of Thy love … Make him successful in the vicinity of Thy gifts and the paradise of Thy presence, grant him Thy greatest bounty and make him a manifestation of endless favors
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá for an ancient servant nourished from early childhood at the breast of God’s love.

selected.text: O God, my God! Verily, Thy kindly maidservant Sakinih hath hastened unto Thee and crossed over to the threshold of Thy mercifulness, hopeful of Thy forgiveness and Thy pardon, seeking Thy grace and Thy bounty, supplicating the kingdom of mercy and entreating the dominion of glory.
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá for Sakinih, who crossed over to the threshold of mercy hopeful of forgiveness.

selected.text: O God! Wash away their sins, guide them from the well to the apex of the moon, admit them into the rose garden of bounty, and shelter them in the meadow of pardon and forgiveness. Make them chief among the free, and cause them to enter the assemblage of them that are nigh unto God.
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá to guide the departed from the well to the apex of the moon and make them chief among the free.

selected.text: her staff at the gate of Thy bounty and has laid down her burden in the courtyard of Thy mercy. Therefore grant her the blessing of meeting Thee and give her to drink from the cup of Thy faithfulness and shelter her near the House of Thy oneness and settle her in the gardens of reunion with
selected.reason: Image of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá of a woman who has laid down her staff and burden at the gate of bounty.

selected.text: O my God! I beseech Thee to forgive and pardon Thy servant who spent his days remembering Thy days. Immerse him in the oceans of Thy mercy, shelter him in the protection of Thy mercy, and guide him to the paradise of Thy presence, just as Thou named him Hadi (Guide) among Thy servants.
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá that Hadi be guided to the paradise of God’s presence, just as God named him Guide.

selected.text: My God, my God! Thou hast created souls from the essences of existence who believed in Thee and in Thy signs … O Lord! Illumine his brow with the manifest light of Thy forgiveness, make his face radiant in Thy glorious Kingdom, clothe him in the robe of pardon through Thy mighty grace
selected.reason: Prayer of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá to illumine the departed’s brow with forgiveness and clothe him in the robe of pardon.

selected.text: We behold him and have sent down each year what We sent down for him during his outward life. In this there is wisdom from Our presence. Thy Lord's knowledge encompasses all the worlds. My mercy preceded him and ascended with him. By My life! It hath encompassed him from all directions.
selected.reason: Words of Bahá’u’lláh that He sends down each year for a departed believer what He sent during his outward life and that His mercy ascended with him; a distinctive word on continuing bounty.

selected.text: O my Lord, the poor one hath verily hastened unto the Kingdom of Thy Wealth, the stranger unto his home within Thy precincts, he that is sore athirst to the heavenly river of Thy Bounty. Deprive him not, O Lord, from his share of the banquet of Thy Grace and from the favour of Thy Bounty
selected.original: O my Lord, the poor one hath verily hastened unto the Kingdom of Thy Wealth, the stranger unto his home within Thy precincts, he that is sore athirst to the heavenly river of Thy Bounty. Deprive him not, O Lord, from his share of the banquet of Thy Grace and from the favour of Thy Bounty  BH03109
selected.reason: Authorized words of Bahá’u’lláh describing the departed as the poor one hastening to the Kingdom of God’s wealth, the stranger to his home and the thirsty one to the river of bounty; carries the guide’s images of welcome.
